ideas.pitch: An offline interactive tool for debugging competitive programming solutions by visually stepping through algorithmic data structures.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the ICPC-style programming contest demographic, making it immediately appealing to the judges who run competitive programming clubs.

ideas.pitch: A localized collaborative coding arena allowing teammates to split subtasks of a single complex algorithmic problem over a local network.
ideas.title: AlgoDuet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the team workflow challenges inherent in 5-hour ICPC-style contests, providing a tangible utility for contestants.

ideas.pitch: A real-time submission statistics and problem difficulty heatmapping tool tailored for short-duration competitive programming contests.
ideas.title: CodeRumble Analytics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Acts as a valuable internal utility for the contest organizers and participants to analyze bottlenecks during the live 5-hour round.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance offline edge-case generator for competitive programmers to stress-test greedy and dynamic programming algorithms.
ideas.title: TestCaseGen Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a persistent pain point for contestants racing against time to find corner cases before submission.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast offline code snippet manager optimized for ICPC rule-books and team reference documents.
ideas.title: SnippetVault Offline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a completely functional, zero-latency local-first application that requires no internet connection, fitting offline contest constraints.
